protocol.preparation_generator: unrestricted leave-one-out heat-bath at the declared production g with additive field theta on label 0
protocol.outcomes: retain all localized labels plus explicit unlocalized/other-phase outcomes
protocol.field_switch: set theta=0 after Tprep, then run the production generator

selection_basis: N3-N10 already-opened data only; fixed theta is the most stable few-defect control variable from task329 and task332 shows low escape from the deep seed for N>=5. No future g data used.
future_test_rule: Do not retune theta or Tprep after choosing the new g holdout. If low-N escape is material, report it as an outcome rather than conditioning it away.
